proofs.text: Give a project a spec `feat` and a spec `other`, mark a skipped test for `other`, and run `--feature feat --quick`; verify `other PROOF-1` is absent from the output and the run exits 0

rule_text: A marker naming a feature this run did not select is not reported as missing

tests.body:
def test_a_marker_for_an_unselected_feature_is_not_named(self, tmp_path):
        root = _pytest_project(tmp_path)
        _spec(root, 'feat')
        _spec(root, 'other')
        (root / 'tests' / 'test_other.py').write_text(
            'import pytest\n\n'
            '@pytest.mark.proof("other", "PROOF-1", "RULE-1")\n'
            '@pytest.mark.skip(reason="no tool here")\n'
            'def test_skipped():\n'
            '    assert True\n', encoding='utf-8')
        code, output = _run(root, '--feature', 'feat', '--quick')
        assert 'other PROOF-1' not in output
        assert code == 0, output
